name: Hearth Ward
description: A protective blessing learned from watching the village elders. Lyrie does not have the precision for grand wards, but she can make a small, wobbling circle of safety around herself. It is not much, but it is home.

params.message: A warm, fuzzy feeling settles around you. The cold softens at the edges of your senses.
A small, warm circle of light surrounds you.
